scope: R200: validate the frame-plan model and prove clip_length is pinned by the 124-frame output, so the VAE overlap waste is structural

model_validation.method: simulate _decode_temporal_output_frame_plan (klvae.py:531) with the exact code and check it reproduces the known 124 output frames
model_validation.verdict: validated: clip_length=17 gives num_chunks=7 and exactly 124 output frames, matching R138s measured shape
model_validation.also_confirms: R199s observation of 196 frames decoded against 124 output, i.e. 1.58x overlap waste, is real

new_proof.claim: clip_length is not tunable - it is pinned by the required 124 output frames
new_proof.consequence: the R199-CORRECTION recommendation of clip_length=16 is invalid since it would change the output from 124 to 148 frames

structural_chain: therefore the 1.58x waste is structurally determined and no temporal-chunking parameter is free

remaining_paths.why: all derived from the output frame count
participates in num_chunks and changes output semantics

remaining_paths.path: change the decode algorithm, e.g. overlap-free causal streaming
remaining_paths.why: changes output content, needs a user criterion
the only semantics-preserving route but needs real conv/attention kernel work

conclusion: the video VAE under-20s target cannot be reached by parameter tuning; the three cheap paths (R139 micro-batching, R198 shuttling, R199 chunk resizing) are all refuted
what_is_still_missing: the per-stage breakdown of where the 21.7 s goes inside the decoder, noted missing in R198 - the only remaining informative VAE step

errors_made: R189 omitted the head factor H=7, producing an impossible 29x headroom
R199 treated the derived tokens_chunk_size as free and got the benefit sign backwards
R199-CORRECTION recommended clip_length=16 without checking it changes the output frame count
methodology_note.pattern: I compute then report, whereas the right order is to establish what constrains a quantity before computing with it
methodology_note.improvement: R200 applied that order first and immediately caught the previous round error
